title: A Language for the Interior
author: Yara Marchetti
blurb: Jude Okafor, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
